paragraphs.text: 1. I PRAISE the God of wondrous might like Indra, the lovely pleasant Guest whom all must welcome.
paragraphs.original: वसुं न चित्रमहसं गृणीषे वामं शेवमतिथिमद्विषेण्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: vasuṃ na citramahasaṃ gṛṇīṣe vāmaṃ śevamatithimadviṣeṇyam |

paragraphs.text: May Agni, Priest and Master of the household, give hero strength and all-sustaining riches.
paragraphs.original: स रासते शुरुधो विश्वधायसोऽग्निर्होता गृहपतिः सुवीर्यम्
paragraphs.translit: sa rāsate śurudho viśvadhāyaso'gnirhotā gṛhapatiḥ suvīryam

paragraphs.text: 2. O Agni, graciously accept this song of mine, thou passing-wise who knowest every ordinance.
paragraphs.original: जुषाणो अग्ने प्रति हर्य मे वचो विश्वानि विद्वान्वयुनानि सुक्रतो ।
paragraphs.translit: juṣāṇo agne prati harya me vaco viśvāni vidvānvayunāni sukrato |

paragraphs.text: Enwrapped in holy oil further the course of prayer: the Gods bestow according to thy holy law.
paragraphs.original: घृतनिर्णिग्ब्रह्मणे गातुमेरय तव देवा अजनयन्ननु व्रतम्
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtanirṇigbrahmaṇe gātumeraya tava devā ajanayannanu vratam

paragraphs.text: 3. Immortal, wandering round the seven stations, give, a liberal Giver, to the pious worshipper,
paragraphs.original: सप्त धामानि परियन्नमर्त्यो दाशद्दाशुषे सुकृते मामहस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: sapta dhāmāni pariyannamartyo dāśaddāśuṣe sukṛte māmahasva |

paragraphs.text: Wealth, Agni, with brave sons and ready for his use: welcome the man who comes with fuel unto thee.
paragraphs.original: सुवीरेण रयिणाग्ने स्वाभुवा यस्त आनट् समिधा तं जुषस्व
paragraphs.translit: suvīreṇa rayiṇāgne svābhuvā yasta ānaṭ samidhā taṃ juṣasva

paragraphs.text: 4. The seven who bring oblations worship thee, the Strong, the first, the Great Chief Priest, Ensign of sacrifice,
paragraphs.original: यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितं हविष्मन्त ईळते सप्त वाजिनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yajñasya ketuṃ prathamaṃ purohitaṃ haviṣmanta īḷate sapta vājinam |

paragraphs.text: The oil-anointed Bull, Agni who hears, who sends as God full hero strength to him who freely gives.
paragraphs.original: शृण्वन्तमग्निं घृतपृष्ठमुक्षणं पृणन्तं देवं पृणते सुवीर्यम्
paragraphs.translit: śṛṇvantamagniṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhamukṣaṇaṃ pṛṇantaṃ devaṃ pṛṇate suvīryam

paragraphs.text: 5. First messenger art thou, meet for election: drink thou thy fill invited to the Anirta,
paragraphs.original: त्वं दूतः प्रथमो वरेण्यः स हूयमानो अमृताय मत्स्व ।
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ dūtaḥ prathamo vareṇyaḥ sa hūyamāno amṛtāya matsva |

paragraphs.text: The Maruts in the votary's house adorned thee; with lauds the Bhrgus gave thee light and glory.
paragraphs.original: त्वां मर्जयन्मरुतो दाशुषो गृहे त्वां स्तोमेभिर्भृगवो वि रुरुचुः
paragraphs.translit: tvāṃ marjayanmaruto dāśuṣo gṛhe tvāṃ stomebhirbhṛgavo vi rurucuḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Milking the teeming Cow for all-sustaining food. O Wise One, for the worship-loving worshipper,
paragraphs.original: इषं दुहन्सुदुघां विश्वधायसं यज्ञप्रिये यजमानाय सुक्रतो ।
paragraphs.translit: iṣaṃ duhansudughāṃ viśvadhāyasaṃ yajñapriye yajamānāya sukrato |

paragraphs.text: Thou, Agni, dropping oil, thrice lighting works of Law, showest thy wisdom circling home and sacrifice.
7. They who at flushing of this dawn appointed thee their messenger, these men have paid thee reverence.
paragraphs.original: त्वामिदस्या उषसो व्युष्टिषु दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त मानुषाः ।
paragraphs.translit: tvāmidasyā uṣaso vyuṣṭiṣu dūtaṃ kṛṇvānā ayajanta mānuṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Gods strengthened thee for work that must be glorified, Agni, while they made butter pure for sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: त्वां देवा महयाय्याय वावृधुराज्यमग्ने निमृजन्तो अध्वरे
paragraphs.translit: tvāṃ devā mahayāyyāya vāvṛdhurājyamagne nimṛjanto adhvare

paragraphs.text: 8. Arrangers in our synods, Agni, while they sang Vasisistha s sons have called thee down, the Potent One.
paragraphs.original: नि त्वा वसिष्ठा अह्वन्त वाजिनं गृणन्तो अग्ने विदथेषु वेधसः ।
paragraphs.translit: ni tvā vasiṣṭhā ahvanta vājinaṃ gṛṇanto agne vidatheṣu vedhasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Maintain the growth of wealth with men who sacrifice. Ye Gods, preserve us with your blessings evermore.
paragraphs.original: रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धारय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
paragraphs.translit: rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamāneṣu dhāraya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
